title: Verify durable file import and visible feedback
goal: Make file import outcomes observable, preserve actionable source access errors, and prove bytes and manifest survive store reinitialization.
context: The importer currently reports all source attribute failures as file-not-found, and Settings gives stale session errors precedence over import errors with no positive save confirmation.
forbidden_changes: Do not weaken file-size limits, path validation, or security-scoped resource handling.
Do not claim physical iPhone verification from package tests.
acceptance_criteria: Successful imports show a saved-local-files confirmation and refresh the imported-file list.
Import-specific errors take precedence over unrelated stale session errors.
Regression tests verify byte integrity and manifest persistence after store reinitialization.
Missing-source import fails without adding a record, and the source filesystem error is preserved.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass.
verification: M3 and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA CI
On-device import of a small text file followed by app restart and read-back
recovery: Revert the single logical task if tests fail or import policy regresses; preserve failing CI evidence.
